text: That was us. Took it on the chin. We will be at the cutoff next year.
For folks asking, official log shows the box was 4 minutes past the cutoff window. That is what triggered rule 4.3.b.
It is a brutal rule but it is the rule. Better luck next time.
Strong showing from a few returning teams. Detroit BBQ is in a good place.
Real work all around this year. Now we figure out the brisket box logistics so this does not happen again.
